# ADR-3216: AWS encryption: Disabled RDS encryption flag for database 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unencrypted RDS snapshots leak easily.

## Decision

Databases SHALL NOT ship a disabled RDS encryption flag for database 8 (AWS-encryption-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Encryption is enabled at create time.
